answer: The protocol enforces anti-Sybil security by subjecting bonded collateral to quadratic slashing penalties that exponentially erode correlated validator deposits. Scaling a Sybil cluster mandates super-linear capital expenditures, ensuring marginal attack costs vastly exceed any value extracted across a cross-chain bridge. This framework renders any malicious state transition voyage irrational through a strictly negative expected utility, E[U] < 0. Consequently, rational participants sustain a robust Nash equilibrium across an ocean of capital lockups.
